patterns.note: An irregular, dynamic masonry-style grid is used to display project images, allowing for varied image sizes and aspect ratios to flow naturally.

All UI text, including navigation and body copy, uses a single, clean sans-serif typeface. Section titles are rendered in large, uppercase, widely-tracked sans-serif text, acting as prominent visual dividers.
The user interface is strictly monochromatic, featuring black text on a pure white background, allowing the rich photography to provide all visual color and depth.
The site header, containing the logo and main navigation, remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while the main content scrolls vertically beneath it.
Sections are delineated by large, uppercase text labels (e.g., 'SPACE', 'URBAN') placed with generous white space, rather than distinct background changes or dividers.

technique_notes: The primary content area uses a flexible grid system, likely CSS Grid or Flexbox with column-count, to arrange images in a non-uniform, gallery-like layout that adapts to image dimensions.

The site's motion system is minimal, primarily featuring a sticky header implemented with a fixed position. Content simply scrolls into view without complex scroll-triggered animations or parallax effects, relying on the natural flow of the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, uppercase, widely-tracked section titles (~3x body) contrast with smaller, standard-weight navigation and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy; generous white space surrounds images and text, particularly around section titles, creating a gallery-like feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its extreme minimalism and reliance on high-quality, full-bleed photography presented in an art-gallery-like, irregular grid. The UI is almost invisible, allowing the visual work to speak entirely for itself.
